items.text: Race-Free Voting & Polls — Vote, close, and claim operations are now atomic, eliminating race conditions when many people vote at once or when background jobs run simultaneously
Rock-Solid Slack Integration — Smarter rate-limit retries, graceful shutdown, and message size guards keep polls posting and updating reliably even under heavy load
No More Lost Input — Switching poll type in the creation modal now preserves your typed question and options
Stronger Security — Ownership checks on poll actions, escaping of user text in Slack messages, and least-privilege automation permissions
Quality Foundation — A comprehensive automated test suite (~92% coverage) and CI pipeline now guard every change
